quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: 'chip' starts with a brief stop before releasing into the hiss - like a /t/ blending into /ʃ/; 'ship' just glides straight into the broad /ʃ/ sound with no stop.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "chip." The /tʃ/ begins with a quick, silent stop of the tongue before releasing into the /ʃ/ sound. "Ship" would skip that stop and start directly with the smooth /ʃ/.
quests.vowelTensionRule: /ʃ/ is one continuous hiss from start to finish. /tʃ/ begins with the tongue fully blocking the air, then releases into that same hiss.
quests.mouthPosition: Lips relaxed, tongue slightly lower and relaxed.
